headline: GitHub spoof project emails Sam Altman users' RAM usage
summary: A GitHub project called ram-altman monitors a PC's RAM usage and emails a report to Sam Altman if utilization falls under 90%. Ars Technica says it verified the RAM figures are real, without actually emailing OpenAI.

claims.statement: The GitHub project 'ram-altman' monitors RAM usage and emails a report to Sam Altman if usage is under 90%.

sources.quote: A new GitHub repository dubbed ram-altman features a script to monitor your PC’s RAM usage and report back to the eponymous OpenAI boss.
Spoof program monitors and emails your RAM usage to Sam Altman if under 90% utilization

claims.statement: The reported RAM usage numbers the script generates are real.

sources.quote: We verified the RAM numbers are real without sending any emails to OpenAI.
